title: Lex fallbacks after a slot type change
scenario: After HelpDeskBot version 8 went live, Larkspur callers hear 'Sorry, I didn't get that' or are asked 'Which system is this about?' repeatedly, and outage reports land with general agents. On-call blames the new voice and wants to lower the confidence threshold; the ServiceNow team needs CMDB codes from the bot. You get conversation logs, analytics, the release note and both deployed bot exports.
task: Diff the deployed bot versions and tie the change to confidence drops and empty slots in the logs
Rule the voice and threshold theories in or out
Fix the slot type so callers are understood and the slot still resolves to CMDB codes
Verify with the eval set and write it up
acceptance: Eval and held-out utterances get the right intent and CMDB code
Outage statements recognized with high confidence
Threshold unchanged; codes kept with spoken synonyms and top resolution
Root cause with evidence in ANSWER.md

practices.label: Week 5 Mon - Lex V2 slots, slot types, resolution and confidence
